newsitem.title: CANADA: SNC-Lavalin to buy engineering firm.
newsitem.headline: SNC-Lavalin to buy engineering firm.

text.p: SNC-Lavalin Group Inc said on Thursday it signed a deal to buy Pellemon Inc, a Canadian employee-owned consulting engineering company, for an undisclosed amount.
The deal is subject to regulatory approval and to the completion of satisfactory due diligence.

Pellemon has a staff of 230 and annual sales of C$19 million. It is involved chiefly in the pharmaceutical sector but also operates in mining and metallurgy, infrastructure including structure, mechanics, roads, water treatment and hydroelectric power.
